reset.title: Reset
reset.subtitle: Sets a member's points, or everyone's, back to zero, and so to the first rank. For example once a year, or after testing.
reset.help: Unchecked, the points history is kept and a "Reset" row is added. Streaks start over from zero. "Also clear the tasks done" empties the task history (done today, activities) without deleting the tasks or moving their due dates. Quests done and challenges won stay counted so they do not pay twice.
reset.confirmKeep: {{who}}: points, rank and streak back to zero. The history is kept.
reset.confirmClear: {{who}}: points, rank and streak back to zero, and points history erased. This cannot be undone.
reset.clearTaskHistory: Also clear the tasks done (task history)
reset.confirmTasks: The history of tasks done is erased too; the tasks themselves stay.
